# WBS 1.4 — Current Data-Vendor Rights and Certification Discovery Scope

Date: 28 October 2026  
Decision: **Prepared / Upstream Rights, Entitlements and Certification Pending**  
Authority: discovery evidence only; no provider selection, contact, purchase, credential, entitlement or production use

## Mandatory baseline

Any future provider decision must satisfy DVR-01–DVR-14, preserve DVM-01–DVM-08, answer VDD-01–VDD-20 and execute PQA-01–PQA-18 against the exact candidate, product, upstream source, terms, account classification and intended use.

## Rights model

- Rights are product-, source-, use-, user-, device-, geography-, environment- and term-version specific.
- A right to view data does not imply non-display, automated screening, risk, order-influencing, storage, derived, redistribution or public-display rights.
- A provider contract does not replace upstream exchange, publisher, issuer, platform or data-owner obligations.
- Derived metrics remain restricted until their inputs and the intended derived use are expressly permitted.
- Social attention cannot satisfy catalyst verification and remains disabled until contract, privacy, deletion and manipulation controls are approved.
- Unknown, expired or disputed entitlement fails closed. It cannot be treated as a technical warning only.

|---|---|---|---|
| DVB-01 | Critical | Open | DF-01–DF-12 operating facts remain Pending. |
| DVB-02 | Critical | Open | Qualified legal/privacy/data-rights conclusions remain unapproved. |
| DVB-03 | Critical | Open | No candidate, product, upstream source or account classification is selected. |
| DVB-04 | Critical | Open | No written display, non-display, derived, storage or redistribution rights exist. |
| DVB-05 | Critical | Open | No complete entitlement, fee, reporting, audit or termination schedule is approved. |
| DVB-06 | Critical | Open | PQA-01–PQA-18 remain NotRun against authorized provider data. |
| DVB-07 | Critical | Open | Security, operations, correction, recovery and support evidence is unaccepted. |
| DVB-08 | Critical | Open | Provider certification, accountable acceptance and downstream production gates remain unavailable. |

## Authority boundary

This scope does not select or recommend a provider, contact a provider, accept terms, subscribe, pay fees, create credentials, enable an entitlement, ingest external data, publish data, execute PQA tests or authorize production, paper or live trading.
